tldr: Chiron transiting the 12th house: a long healing chapter around solitude, rest, hidden patterns, endings, dreams, and spiritual retreat.
body: Chiron moving through the 12th house can reopen old material around solitude, rest, hidden patterns, endings, dreams, and spiritual retreat. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is hidden, even from you; it lives in the unconscious, in solitude, in what you cannot name.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through solitude, rest, hidden patterns, endings, dreams, and spiritual retreat. You hold space for others' unspoken pain and inner life.
shadow: Letting the wound run things from the dark until you bring it to light.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 12th house deliberately. Work with solitude, rest, hidden patterns, endings, dreams, and spiritual retreat as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
